part.weight_note: Title-block mass of 0.8 kg is incorrect. Calculated finished weight per piece ~2.33 g; 10 pieces ~23.3 g.

chamfer_mm.note: Chamfer location not fully clear on drawing — confirm if all four circular edges require chamfer. If yes, callout should read: C0.5 x 45 deg — 4 PLACES

current_drawing_interpretation.note: All three dimensions are written with two decimal places. Title-block general tolerance therefore applies as +/- 0.02 mm to all three.

ID_mm.note: ID is currently allowed to be smaller than 5.50

OD_mm.note: OD is currently allowed to be larger than 12.50

ID_unilateral_positive.use_when: Guaranteed minimum clearance required — hole must never be smaller than 5.50 mm

OD_unilateral_negative.use_when: OD must never exceed 12.50 mm — ensures washer fits into pocket or bore

thickness_unilateral_negative.use_when: Extra thickness causes interference or changes assembly height — must not exceed 3.00

thickness_unilateral_positive.use_when: Minimum spacing, strength or preload must be maintained — must not go below 3.00

recommended_callout_for_assembly.note: Recommended only — must be confirmed against mating shaft diameter, pocket diameter and required assembled height. Do not assume unilateral tolerance from feature type; must be explicitly written on drawing.

drawing_clarifications.description: Drawing shows 0.5 x 45 deg callout but does not clearly state how many edges require chamfer. If all four circular edges (front OD, front ID, rear OD, rear ID) require chamfer, update callout to: C0.5 x 45 deg — 4 PLACES.
No Ra or surface texture symbol on drawing. Recommended: faces Ra 1.6-3.2 um, OD and ID Ra 1.6-3.2 um.
C45 is hardenable but no hardness requirement appears on drawing. Manufacture in normalized / as-turned condition. Do not harden unless designer adds explicit hardness callout.
Drawing shows 0.8 kg. Calculated actual weight per piece ~2.33 g; 10 pieces ~23.3 g. Correct before release.

drawing_clarifications.topic: Tolerance direction not specified for functional features
drawing_clarifications.description: Current drawing applies +/- 0.02 mm bilaterally to all dimensions because they are written with two decimal places. For assembly, designer should consider unilateral tolerances: ID +0.02/0, OD 0/-0.02. See tolerance_discussion section for options.

drawing_clarifications.topic: Shop-control geometric requirements not on drawing
drawing_clarifications.description: OD-to-ID concentricity TIR <= 0.03 mm, face parallelism <= 0.02 mm, face flatness <= 0.02 mm, and surface finish Ra 1.6-3.2 um are recommended shop controls but are not formal drawing requirements. Add to drawing if washer is used in precision die, spring assembly or guide mechanism.

raw_material.workholding_preference: Collet chuck preferred over standard three-jaw chuck — better concentricity for small component

tooling_list.tool: T01 — VCGT or DCMT finishing insert

tooling_list.purpose: Drill starting position — prevents small drill from wandering

tooling_list.tool: T04 — O5.50 machine reamer or small boring bar
Second-op fixture — stepped soft jaws or expanding mandrel

process_sequence.name: Incoming material inspection
checks: C45 material certificate — verify batch number
Bar diameter O14 or O16 mm
Surface — no rust, scale, seams or cracks

process_sequence.name: CNC turning — Operation 10 (first side — machined from bar)
process_sequence.workholding: O14 or O16 mm collet — keep bar projection as short as practical
sequence: Step 1 — Face the bar: light finishing cut, no centre pip. This becomes Face A (Z0 datum).
Step 2 — Spot drill lightly on spindle centre.
Step 3 — Drill rough hole O5.20 or O5.30 through (depth minimum 5-6 mm).
Step 4 — Finish ID: preferred method is ream to O5.50 mm using O5.30 pre-drill + O5.50 machine reamer with continuous coolant. Alternative: CNC bore to O5.500, target O5.495-5.505.
Step 5 — Rough-turn OD to O12.55-12.60 mm, finish-turn to O12.500 mm. Target O12.495-12.505. Turn OD for at least 3.5-4.0 mm length.
Step 6 — Machine front chamfers: OD edge C0.5 x 45 deg, ID edge C0.5 x 45 deg if confirmed. Do not exceed 0.5 mm — only ~2 mm of full cylindrical length will remain if both faces are chamfered.

Step 7 — Part off at 3.15-3.20 mm thickness (recommended 3.20 mm — leaves ~0.20 mm for second-op facing). Use sharp parting blade, continuous coolant, low feed near centre. Use parts catcher — do not let part fall into chip conveyor.
process_sequence.step_8_repeat: Repeat steps 1-7 for all 10 pieces. Face remaining bar before each new piece.

O5_5_HSS_reaming.note: Do not stop or reverse reamer inside hole

parting.note: Reduce feed near centre. Abundant coolant.

process_sequence.name: CNC turning — Operation 20 (second side — finish the parted face)
process_sequence.purpose: Face parted side and bring thickness to 3.00 mm. Machine rear chamfers.

preparation: Install aluminium or mild-steel soft jaws in CNC lathe
Bore a shallow pocket in jaws while clamped under machining pressure
Pocket diameter: O12.49-12.50 mm (adjusted to actual OD of first piece)
Flat axial locating shoulder with small corner relief so part seats fully
advantages: Lower risk of part coming loose
Less chance of distorting small ID
Finished OD completely free — no jaw marks
limitations: Mandrel is very small and delicate for O5.50 ID / 3 mm thick washer
Too much expansion can increase hole size, distort washer, make hole oval, or damage ID surface
Tighten only enough to prevent movement during light facing
alternative.use_when: When finished OD must remain completely free from gripping marks

second_op_sequence: Step 1 — Load part: place already-finished Face A against jaw shoulder (or mandrel shoulder). Very low clamping pressure — part is only 3 mm thick.
Step 2 — Face to final thickness: rough remove 0.10-0.12 mm, semi-finish leave 0.03-0.05 mm, final pass 0.03-0.05 mm. Target 3.000 mm. Acceptable 2.98-3.02 mm. Internal target 2.995-3.005 mm.
Step 3 — Machine rear chamfers: rear OD edge C0.5 x 45 deg, rear ID edge C0.5 x 45 deg if required. Verify first piece with profile projector or chamfer gauge.

Step 4 — Deburr: remove ID drilling/reaming burr, parting burr, chamfer intersection burr, all sharp edges on both faces. Use fine ceramic stone, deburring blade or light abrasive pad. Do not round off controlled chamfers.
process_sequence.thickness_measurement_note: Measure frequently during initial setup — thermal growth and insert nose radius affect +/- 0.02 mm thickness control.

process_sequence.name: Deburring and visual check
actions: Remove all burrs — ID, OD, both faces, chamfer intersections
Use fine ceramic stone, deburring blade or light abrasive pad
Visual check for parting marks, chatter, cracks, jaw marks, rust

process_sequence.name: 100% dimensional inspection
process_sequence.note: Inspect all 10 pieces. Measure after parts stabilise at ambient temperature.

inspection_plan.equipment: 0-25 mm outside micrometer — do NOT rely on vernier caliper alone for +/- 0.02 mm tolerance
inspection_plan.positions: Two angular positions to detect ovality

inspection_plan.equipment: Pin gauges, small bore gauge, air gauge if available, or GO/NO-GO plug gauges
inspection_plan.pin_check: 5.48 mm pin must enter freely; 5.52 mm pin must not pass freely
inspection_plan.note: Gauge design must include gauge-maker tolerance and wear allowance

inspection_plan.positions: Four positions — 12, 3, 6, 9 o-clock. Variation between positions indicates face parallelism.

inspection_plan.equipment: Profile projector for first-piece approval, chamfer gauge for remaining pieces

shop_control_recommendations.note: Not formal drawing requirements — apply as good manufacturing practice
shop_control_recommendations.add_to_drawing_if: Washer is used in precision die, spring assembly or guide mechanism

process_sequence.name: Cleaning and packing
actions: Wash parts to remove coolant and chips
Pack individually or separate using oiled paper
Attach inspection report showing OD, ID and thickness readings for each piece

machine_allocation.operation: Operation 10 — facing, drilling, reaming, OD turning, chamfer, parting

machine_allocation.equipment: CNC turning centre with stepped soft jaws or expanding mandrel
Outside micrometer, pin gauges or bore gauge, profile projector

expanding_mandrel_explanation.purpose: Holds washer by its ID (O5.50 mm) after parting, leaving the finished OD completely free
components: Small cylindrical pilot that enters the O5.50 hole
Shoulder against which the finished face of the washer rests
Draw screw or taper nut that causes expansion
Very limited total expansion — enough to grip, not enough to distort
operation_sequence: Push already-finished face against the axial shoulder
Face the rough parted side to 3.00 mm
Machine rear OD and ID chamfers
limitations_for_this_washer: Mandrel is very small — pilot only ~O5.48-5.49 mm
Washer is only 3 mm thick — very short axial grip
Excessive expansion increases hole size beyond 5.52 mm
Distortion or ovality possible if over-tightened
Tighten only enough to resist light facing force
expanding_mandrel_explanation.verdict: Stepped soft jaws are generally easier and safer for quantity 10. Use expanding mandrel only when jaw marks on OD are unacceptable.

stepped_soft_jaw_detail.jaw_pocket_diameter_mm: O12.49-12.50 (bore to match actual OD of first turned piece)
stepped_soft_jaw_detail.corner_relief: Small relief so washer seats fully against flat axial shoulder
stepped_soft_jaw_detail.chuck_pressure: Very low — excess pressure causes OD to go three-lobed
stepped_soft_jaw_detail.measurement_check: Verify pocket diameter with bore gauge before loading first piece
thickness_variation_causes: Burr between part and jaw shoulder
Part not seated flat against shoulder
Parting face allowance too uneven between pieces

route_summary: C45 bar receipt -> material verification -> CNC Op10: face (Face A), spot-drill, drill O5.2-5.3, ream / bore ID to O5.50, rough and finish-turn OD to O12.500, front chamfers C0.5x45, part off at 3.15-3.20 mm -> repeat for all 10 pieces -> CNC Op20: load in stepped soft jaws (or expanding mandrel) with finished face against stop, face parted side to 3.00 mm, rear chamfers, deburr -> 100% inspection: OD O12.48-12.52, ID O5.48-5.52, thickness 2.98-3.02 at 4 positions -> clean, rust-protect, pack with inspection report.

recommended_final_specification.chamfer: 0.5 x 45 deg — confirm 4 places with designer
